speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: Making the rotor blades more visible should significantly reduce the number of bird collisions.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: This is particularly important during periods of heavy migration.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The measure would strengthen our efforts to protect migratory birds and the Ramsar wetland.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: Fortunately, painting the blades should have little to no effect on the energy output of the turbines.

speaker: TOURISM BOARD
text: There is, however, a concern from the tourism sector.

speaker: TOURISM BOARD
text: The brighter blades will be much more visible from the coastline and major viewing points.

speaker: TOURISM BOARD
text: This could negatively affect the visual experience that attracts visitors to the coast.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The measure therefore provides strong protection for SDG 15 without significantly affecting energy production, but it may come at a cost to coastal tourism.
